content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research addresses rule-based and parametric layout generation for automated composition workflows, including constraint-driven document design that can adapt content placement across varying structural formats.","sources":[{"id":"R0519","field":"bio","quote":"His research group focuses on parametric and constraint-driven document composition"},{"id":"R0519","field":"keywords","quote":"parametric layout, constraint-based composition, automated prepress"}]},{"text":"Work on modular grid parameterization demonstrates methods to automatically adapt layout structures across different page geometries by expressing design rules as functions of format dimensions.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06101","field":"abstract","quote":"column count, gutter width, and margin ratios are expressed as functions of the page aspect ratio"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-06101","field":"title","quote":"Adapting Modular Grids Across Five Standard Paper Formats"}]},{"text":"Background includes direct prepress consulting experience with packaging clients, developing automated template workflows for production environments with known vendor constraints.","sources":[{"id":"R0519","field":"industry_experience","quote":"working as a freelance publication designer and prepress consultant for regional printing companies, developing automated template workflows for catalogue and packaging clients"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher's focus on parametric composition, constraint-based layout generation, and automated template adaptation for print production [R0519, SYN-PUB-06101] directly addresses the core challenge of automating artwork placement into structural dielines with varying anchor points and bleed zones, and prior packaging industry experience ensures awareness of vendor file-format requirements [R0519]."}
